parameters.content:
## Stage 2 · Extract and Validate Browser Capture
**Input:** Downloaded browser-capture-schema-v1 artifact  ·  **Output:** Redacted READY_FOR_HEADLESS receipt  ·  **Nodes:** 9–10
The browser branch never enters the statement parser or a finance writer. Any rejected invariant stops this stage and routes only a redacted failure receipt to the shared error workflow.
